title: Divaldo: O Mensageiro da Paz
overview: استمتع بمشاهدة فيلم Divaldo: Mensageiro Paz مترجم بجودة عالية.

ai_content.intro: يحكي هذا العمل قصة ديفالدو فرانكو، الذي عاش مع mediumship منذ عمره 4 سنوات.
ai_content.desc_ar: استمتع بمشاهدة فيلم Divaldo: Mensageiro Paz مترجم بجودة عالية.
ai_content.desc_en: This film tells the story of Divaldo Franco, born in a small town in Bahia, in the interior. Since he was 4 years old, Divaldo lived with mediumship, which disturbed him about what he saw. However, the child suffered a difficult childhood, being rejected by other children and violently by his father. However, Divaldo was able to transform into his mission at 17, with the support of his mother, he became interested in Spiritism, which led him to move to Salvador to study this philosophy. Under the guidance of his spiritual guide, Joanna de ngelis, the young man was able to overcome the homesickness and the loneliness of the big city, and set his principle, to become Divaldo Franco one of the most important mediums in history, and put his personal life in service of charity and congregations.

ai_content.outro: يعد ديفالدو فرانكو أحد أهم mediums في التاريخ، حيث قدم حياته في خدمة الخير والطوائف.
ai_content.opinion_ar: يعد ديفالدو فرانكو أحد أهم في التاريخ، حيث قدم حياته في خدمة الخير والطوائف. مع وجود منذ عمره 4 سنوات، أصبح ديفالدو مهتمًا بتعاليم الروحانية، مما أدى إلى تحوله إلى سلفادور لدراسة هذه الفلسفة.
ai_content.opinion_en: Divaldo Franco is one of the most important mediums in history, where he gave his life in service of charity and congregations. With the presence of mediumship since he was 4 years old, Divaldo became interested in Spiritism, which led him to move to Salvador to study this philosophy.
